headline: Wendy's Receives $1.4 Billion Take-Private Proposal From Peltz Group
summary: Fast-food chain Wendy's received a $1.4 billion take-private offer from an investor group led by Nelson Peltz.
why: Wendy's is a major quick-service restaurant operator in North America; buyout offers often catalyze re-ratings across the fast-food sector.

impacts.name: The Wendy's Company
impacts.why: Takeover offers from major shareholders usually incorporate an acquisition premium over current market prices.

why_moved: A formal take-private offer typically drives equity prices higher toward the proposed valuation.
